_comment: Ownership manifest for scripts/template-sync.mjs (docs/SYNC.md). Every file tracked in the template repo is SHARED unless it matches `client` (each client repo owns its copy; sync never overwrites it) or `templateOnly` (never copied to clients). Globs: `*` = within one folder, `**` = any depth. This file is itself shared, so a rule change here reaches every client on its next pull.
